summary: Phantasy Star entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Phantasy Star Online
entries.definitive_edition: GameCube Episode I & II Plus for official offline preservation; Blue Burst separately for Episode IV/server-history coverage

emulation.notes: Original hardware is preferred for hardware/controller context; emulator route must document network/private-server state if used.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: GameCube hardware/offline route for official content; PC Blue Burst for Episode IV comparison

primary.version: Phantasy Star Online Episode I & II Plus
primary.why: The Dreamcast original is the launch artifact, but official online service is long gone. GameCube Episode I & II Plus is the strongest official offline preservation route for the core game, while Blue Burst adds Episode IV but depends on historical/community server context rather than a current official server.
primary.how_to_play: Use the GameCube Episode I & II Plus release on original hardware or accurate emulation. Record region, serial/access key state if relevant, offline/online state, character class/section ID, episode/quest, multiplayer setup, and whether Dreamcast original or Blue Burst was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original launch route and Dreamcast online-service history
secondary.what_to_play: Use for launch-version preservation and historical comparison.
secondary.why: It is the original release, but official online service state cannot be recreated normally.

secondary.exclusive_content: Episode IV content and PC online-client route
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting Blue Burst separately with server provenance labeled.
secondary.why: It is the broadest content branch, but official server availability is a preservation caveat.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record official-service shutdown state and do not present private/community servers as official Sega service.
